title: Prepare for Setbacks
subtitle: A temporary increase in symptoms does not automatically mean you have lost all progress.
description: Use your individualized clinical guidance. Seek appropriate care for new, severe, rapidly worsening, or otherwise concerning symptoms.

fields.label: What are your usual early signs that a difficult period may be building?
What helps you distinguish a familiar flare from something that needs clinical advice?
Which options may belong in your plan?
options: Temporarily adjust the dose of activity
Keep some comfortable movement in the day
Use a calming or breathing strategy

fields.label: Write your first three steps in order.

successMessage: Setback plan saved. A prepared response can reduce guesswork when symptoms change.
